 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA
ORAL ORDER 2 13-08-2024 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.
The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 511 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are persons with clean antecedent and the informant alleges that the accused persons kept her minor daughter as domestic help,
further Md. Babban, on pretext of marriage, started establishing physical relation, while Md. Nadim also Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.41290 of 2024(2) dt.13-08-2024 touched her inappropriately,
on which her daughter informed the petitioner No. 1, but she did not take any action, further Md.
Babban continuously established physical relation.

It is next alleged that marriage of Md. Babban was fixed, thereafter petitioner No. 1 told the victim not to disclose her relationship with Babban Hasna Begam @ Husanbano @ Hasnabano vs The State Of Bihar on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56826647/
1 and she will give an amount of Rs. 1 lakh.
4.

entities.text: Babban Hasna Begam @ Husanbano @ Hasnabano vs The State Of Bihar on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have been falsely implicated in the instant case by the informant.
It is further submitted that victim and Babban were in love, further victim is a major aged about 20 years.
It is also submitted that statement of the victim was recorded by Mahila Police Station wherein she accepted the fact that she was in love with Babban.

It is further submitted that when relationship with Babban soured, the present false case came to instituted implicating his entire family members including his mother (Petitioner No. 1) and his brothers.
It is also submitted that even the Medical Board does not confirm sexual assault.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

6. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the petitioners above-named, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the learned trial court Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.41290 of 2024(2) dt.13-08-2024 within a period of six weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Bisfi (Patauna) P.S. Case No. 489 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
